description: Phase 3-Soak secondary 1. Drives the experimental-gate cross-product across the 1k-client × 30-day soak: 50% of clients have engine_set_experimental_families_enabled(0), 50% have (1). The verifier walks per-client activation ledgers and asserts: (a) every gate-OFF client's ledger contains zero activations of an Experimental family (`webtunnel`, `snowflake`, `masque`, `psiphon`, `conjure`, `transport_module`); (b) every gate-ON client has at least one Experimental activation by simulated end of soak. Day 1 every client starts with the gate set per its assigned half. Day 7 every gate-ON client must have activated at least one Experimental family. Day 14 final ledger: experimental_gate_cross_product_pass = true. Locked at 3-Soak per `phases of development/27-phase-3-soak-success-metric.md` §6 secondary 1.
